summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of SentinelPulse PWA. Backend API testing achieved 97.2% success rate (35/36 tests passed). Frontend testing achieved 100% success with all screens, navigation, and key interactions working correctly. Gemini AI integration confirmed operational. OpenStreetMap/Leaflet provider working as expected. All core safety features functional including emergency workflow, evidence vault, journey mode, and privacy controls.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 404 'Evidence not found' when called after privacy data deletion
minor_bugs.impact: Export functionality fails if user has deleted evidence records via privacy controls
minor_bugs.note: This may be expected behavior if evidence was deleted, but endpoint should handle empty state gracefully
